title: Request for Quotation — a supplier invitation to quote
description: Price discovery, not a commitment: an RFQ names the suppliers it invites and the items it wants quoted, and it is the buying cycle's first step. Its lines carry an OPTIONAL rate, because a line is unpriced until the supplier has answered; the conversion to a purchase order is what requires the rate, and it refuses a line that never got one. The field shapes it composes are ERP-02's: the identifier, label, quantity and rate definitions are $ref'd out of integrations/erp/core/schemas/document.schema.json rather than restated, so a quantity or a currency code means one thing across the whole module.

valid_till.description: The date the invitation lapses. Absent means no declared expiry.

suppliers.description: The suppliers invited to quote. At least one: an invitation nobody received is not a request.

rate.description: The supplier's quoted rate, carried once the quotation returns. Optional here and required at conversion — a priced order cannot be built from an unpriced line.

harvest: the request-for-quotation field surface (invited suppliers, item lines, validity)
an invitation to quote as a document distinct from the order it may become
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream request-for-quotation doctype, re-expressed as our own schema and workflow data. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
